pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Es geht" mean as an answer to "Wie geht's?" (1 mark)
   A. It is goodbye
   B. It is so-so
   C. It is very bad
   D. It is very good

2. What does "der Onkel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. family
   B. uncle
   C. brothers and sisters
   D. mother

3. What does "die Uhr" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cooker
   B. house
   C. clock
   D. table

4. Which of these is a piece of furniture? (1 mark)
   A. der Stuhl
   B. die Küche
   C. der Garten
   D. das Haus

5. Which day comes right after Samstag? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Montag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Sonntag

6. What does "Ja" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good night
   B. please
   C. yes
   D. sorry, excuse me

7. What does "die Geschwister" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. aunt
   B. brothers and sisters
   C. brother
   D. daughter

8. What does "die Schwester" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brothers and sisters
   B. aunt
   C. daughter
   D. sister

9. What does "vor dem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. behind the house
   B. in the house
   C. in front of the house
   D. under the house

10. What does "das Schlafzimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. clock
   B. wall
   C. bedroom
   D. sofa

11. Which two words is "Wochenende" made from? (1 mark)
   A. Wochen and Tag
   B. Tag and Ende
   C. Woche and Tag
   D. Woche and Ende

12. What does "oft" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. often
   C. always
   D. yesterday

13. Which German word is the number 1? (1 mark)
   A. fünf
   B. eins
   C. zehn
   D. elf

14. Which German word is the number 12? (1 mark)
   A. eins
   B. neun
   C. zwei
   D. zwölf

15. What does "März" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. March
   B. July
   C. September
   D. August

16. Which food group does "der Tee" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. das Obst
   C. das Gemüse
   D. die Getränke

17. Which food group does "die Banane" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Obst

18. What does "warm" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. wet
   B. dry
   C. warm
   D. cool

19. What is the plural of "die Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. die Wolke
   B. die Wolken
   C. die Wolker
   D. die Wolkes

20. Which form completes "Du ___ nett"? (1 mark)
   A. sind
   B. bin
   C. ist
   D. bist

21. Which little word goes with the noun "Opa"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

22. What is the plural of "der Tisch"? (1 mark)
   A. die Tischs
   B. die Tischer
   C. die Tischen
   D. die Tische

23. Which little word goes with the noun "Badezimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. der
   D. die

24. What does "der neunte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. ninth
   B. third
   C. eighth
   D. tenth

25. What does "der siebte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. second
   B. eighth
   C. first
   D. seventh

26. Which mark comes after a meal name in a menu, as in "Frühstück: Tee und Brot"? (1 mark)
   A. a colon
   B. a hyphen
   C. a full stop
   D. a question mark

27. Which food group does "die Bohne" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Obst
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Gemüse
   D. die Getränke

28. Which German word or phrase means "apple"? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. der Fisch
   C. das Brot
   D. der Apfel

29. Which German word or phrase means "back"? (1 mark)
   A. das Auge
   B. der Rücken
   C. der Bauch
   D. das Knie

30. Which word has a silent h that makes the vowel long? (1 mark)
   A. Mund
   B. Zahn
   C. Bauch
   D. Kopf

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write these numbers in German: 14, 16, 18. (3 marks)

32. Write the German for: sun, rain, wind, sky. Use der, die or das. (4 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear. (3 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: head, eye, mouth, hand. (4 marks)

35. Write these numbers in German: 5, 8, 13. (3 marks)

36. Give two reasons why fruit and vegetables are good for the body. (2 marks)

37. Name the three umlaut letters and the special letter ß. (2 marks)

38. Read: "In Mombasa ist es heiß." Say what it means and how to say heiß. (2 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: family, cabbage or kale, toilet, fog, bed. (5 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shoulder, son. (2 marks)

41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cocoa, party. (2 marks)

42. Write these numbers in German: 4, 9, 12. (3 marks)

43. Write a short weather report in German with a greeting, weather and a goodbye. (4 marks)

44. Write the German words with their articles for: fridge, cooker, plate, spoon. (4 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: hand, bread, maize. (3 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: wall, tea, tooth, cocoa. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — It is so-so
   Es geht means it is okay, so-so.

2. B — uncle
   der Onkel means uncle.

3. C — clock
   die Uhr means clock.

4. A — der Stuhl
   A chair (der Stuhl) is furniture. The others are places.

5. D — Sonntag
   After Samstag comes Sonntag.

6. C — yes
   Ja means yes.

7. B — brothers and sisters
   die Geschwister means brothers and sisters.

8. D — sister
   die Schwester means sister.

9. C — in front of the house
   vor means in front of.

10. C — bedroom
   das Schlafzimmer means bedroom.

11. D — Woche and Ende
   Woche = week and Ende = end, so weekend.

12. B — often
   oft means often.

13. B — eins
   1 in German is eins.

14. D — zwölf
   12 in German is zwölf.

15. A — March
   März means March.

16. D — die Getränke
   der Tee belongs to die Getränke.

17. D — das Obst
   die Banane belongs to das Obst.

18. C — warm
   warm means warm.

19. B — die Wolken
   The plural of die Wolke is die Wolken.

20. D — bist
   du goes with bist.

21. D — der
   It is der Opa, so the little word is der.

22. D — die Tische
   The plural of der Tisch is die Tische.

23. B — das
   It is das Badezimmer, so the little word is das.

24. A — ninth
   der neunte means ninth.

25. D — seventh
   der siebte means seventh.

26. A — a colon
   The colon announces what follows.

27. C — das Gemüse
   die Bohne belongs to das Gemüse.

28. D — der Apfel
   apple in German is der Apfel.

29. B — der Rücken
   back in German is der Rücken.

30. B — Zahn
   Zahn has a silent h after the a.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: vierzehn, sechzehn, achtzehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, der Regen, der Wind, der Himmel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kopf, das Auge, der Mund, die Hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: fünf, acht, dreizehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give vitamins and energy; they help us to stay healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: ä, ö, ü and ß (Eszett).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three umlauts and 1 mark for ß.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: In Mombasa it is hot. heiß is said like hice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

39. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Familie, der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schulter, der Sohn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Kakao, die Party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: vier, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen! Heute ist es sonnig und warm. Es ist nicht windig. Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for weather sentences, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for the goodbye.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kühlschrank, der Herd, der Teller, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Hand, das Brot, der Mais.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Wand, der Tee, der Zahn, der Kakao.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).
